create_layerwise_memory_tracker: create a LayerwiseMemoryTracker to monitor memory usage of a PyTorch model during forward and backward passes
test_layerwise_memory_tracker: test the LayerwiseMemoryTracker by monitoring a model's forward/backward pass and retrieving memory traces
summarize_checkpoint_suggestions: summarize suggested checkpoint locations for activation memory reset given model memory traces and number of checkpoints
review_memory_traces_plot: review memory traces by generating a 6-panel plot showing allocated memory, reserved memory, activations, and all-gathered data
run_checkpoint_placement: run find_best_reset_points to compute optimal checkpoint placement boundaries given activation sizes and number of checkpoints
